gaps.explanation: Governmental funds statement (trimmed pp4-5, two facing pages), Other financing sources (uses): 'Transfers to other funds' General Fund (285,936), Parks & Rec Fund (31,869) (p4); 'Transfers from other funds' Street Fund 56,373 (p4), Econ Dev Fund 36,098, Police Fund 194,805, Housing Fund 38,201, Other Governmental Funds 37,328 (p5). Total Governmental Funds column (not used): out (317,805), in 362,805. None was in detail. The only governmental transfer line in detail was detail[27], the General Fund budgetary comparison schedule (p10, a governmental-only schedule of the governmental departments) 'Transfers from other funds' 45,000 = exactly the net of the gross cells now added for the same governmental funds (362,805 - 317,805 = 45,000). It is the same money counted twice once the gross lines are in, so it is removed; the money is held by the seven added fund-column lines. Utility transfers out (Electric, Sewer, Water (15,000) each, p7) are already in detail and are not touched. Loan repayments (19,553) Econ Dev and (2,703) Other Governmental Funds are already in detail as budget-schedule expenditure lines.
